rows.grounds: compound: sva-karma-saṃskriyā-āvedhāt (abl.) + tat-loke (loc., sandhi @); L1/L2: own-rite refinement and its effect in that world
citra-tā-juṣaḥ (nom. pl. m.); L1/L2: those who partake of variety/manifoldness
gen. pl. m. of puṃs; L1/L2: of people/individuals
paśu-mātrāṇām (gen. pl. m.); L1/L2: those limited to the state of paśu (bound soul)
sālokyam (nom./acc. sg. n.) + avivekataḥ (abl.); L1/L2: sālokya (dwelling in same world) due to lack of discrimination
